---
name: Effect request · 想要的特效
about: Ask for an effect or camera move the library does not have
title: "[effect] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What should the viewer see? / 观众会看到什么**
<!-- a few frames in words: what moves, how long, how it eases -->

**When would you use it? / 在什么场景用**
<!-- a PV drop, a title card, a transition between two scenes... -->

**A reference (optional) / 参考（可选）**
<!-- a link is fine; please do not attach clips or code from works you do not own.
     Code can be copied into this repo only from MIT / Apache-2.0 / BSD / ISC / zlib / CC0 sources. -->

**Would you like to build it? / 你愿意自己做吗**
<!-- see CONTRIBUTING.md, an effect is one file -->
